'''Tin''' is a crafting material smelted from [[Tin Ore]] in a [[Smelter]].

Just like [[Copper Ore]], [[Tin Ore]] can only be found in the [[Black Forest]] [[Biomes|biome]]. It takes the form of small shiny rock-like deposits on the ground near water (ocean & river shorelines, or small inland lakes).

An [[Antler Pickaxe]] or better is required to mine the rocks, which yield 2-4 Tin ore each.

One Tin can be processed with two [[Copper]] on the [[Forge]] to create one [[Bronze]]. There is also an alternate recipe to craft 5 Bronze at a time given sufficient materials (10 copper, 5 tin).

'''Copper Ore''' can be refined into [[Copper]] in a [[Smelter]].

Two Copper can be further processed at a [[Forge]] with [[Tin]] to yield [[Bronze]].

== Availability ==
It can be mined from [[Copper Deposit]]s which can be found in [[Black Forest]] [[biomes]] using any [[Pickaxes (skill)|Pickaxe]]. Such deposits have subtle bronze-colored streaks that reflect the sunlight. It is the only visual feature that distinguishes them from typical stone boulders.

Copper deposits are generated in a large size which extends down into the ground, so digging deep underneath the surface is necessary to fully extract a single deposit.

== Notes ==
* A way of farming Copper is to dig the earth all around the deposit until it crumbles on itself into Copper Ores. 
* Like other metals, Copper Ore cannot be teleported without a [[Portal stone]].
* The attacks of a [[Troll]], despite being harmless to normal terrain, cause immense damage to Copper Ore. If the player has no pickaxe or simply yearns for a change from their usual monotonous mining method, a Troll can make for a great alternative.

'''Silver Ore''' is a raw metal that can be mined from [[Silver Vein]]s found in [[Mountain]] biomes above 120 meters using an [[Iron Pickaxe]] or better. The ore can be smelted into [[Silver]] using a [[Smelter]].

== Availability ==
Silver Veins can be found using the [[Wishbone]] obtained from [[Bonemass]].

Alternatively, hitting the ground with the [[Stagbreaker]] or the [[Wooden Sledge]] may reveal underground silver deposits through the "too hard" message that appears when a silver vein is in the damage area of the two-handed club.

Trenching your positions may inadvertently reveal silver veins, provided you are above 120 meters in elevation. Despite the ground appearing frozen, it is no more difficult to dig in the Mountains than in other biomes, so hitting a vein by sheer luck is not out of the question.

== Notes ==
* Like other metals, Silver Ore cannot be teleported without a [[Portal Stone]].
* If Drakes and Obsidian (100 meters for both) are spawning near the player, they are close to the height needed (120 meters) for Silver to spawn.
* [[Cart]]s may be difficult to use in the Mountains due to the slopes but can be useful to help reduce further trips.
* Silver ore is the heaviest ore of all the ore types.
* Silver Veins cannot be mined by [[Stone Golem]]s or using an [[Antler Pickaxe]].

[[Ancient Armor]] | usage = Smelting | buy = | sell = | weight = 10.0 | stack = 30 | teleport = No }} '''Scrap Iron''' is a raw metal that can be turned into [[Iron]] in a [[Smelter]] using [[Coal]] as fuel. == Availability == In the [[Swamp]], its primary source are [[Sunken Crypts]]. There, it can be mined from [[Muddy Scrap Pile]]s using any pickaxe, or found inside [[Chest]]s. The [[Swamp Key]], obtained from the [[Elder]], has to be obtained to access Sunken Crypts. Alternatively, Muddy scrap piles can be found underground in Swamps. However, these are scarce, and ultimately yield little Iron scrap. They can be located using a [[Wishbone]] or by using the [[How to play#How_to_prospect_properly?|Prospecting]] method with a [[Stagbreaker]] or Weapons with the same attack ([[Iron Sledge]]). [[Oozer]]s can also rarely drop Scrap iron with a drop rate of around 30%. Later in the game, Iron and [[Copper Scrap]] can be obtained by mining [[Ancient Sword]]s and [[Ancient Armor]] in the [[Mistlands]]. == Notes == * Like other metals, Scrap Iron cannot be teleported without a [[Portal stone]]. * Scrap iron ore is 2 units lighter than smelted Iron. {{MaterialsNav}} [[ru:Металлолом]] [[cs:Železný šrot]] [[uk:Металобрухт]] [[de:Eisenschrott]] [[fr:Ferraille]]

[[Abandoned Village]] [[Barrel]]s. | usage = Building, Crafting, Farming, Taming | weight = 0.2 | stack = 100 | teleport = Yes | crop = 2 Flax | grow time = {{duration|4000}}-{{duration|5000}} | cultivated = Yes | radius = 0.5 | biomes = [[Plains]] }} '''Flax''' is a material that can be found in [[Fuling Village]]s within the [[Plains]] biome, as a small patch of cultivated land or in chests, as well as in the [[Barrel]]s inside the [[Abandoned Village]]s in the [[Deep North]]. It is more common to find [[Barley]] in cultivated spots in the [[Fuling Village]]s , so it may be necessary to search multiple villages. Flax can only be re-grown within the [[Plains]] biome, and is done by replanting it with a [[Cultivator]]. It takes between 4,000 seconds and 5,000 seconds (between 66 minutes 40 seconds and 83 minutes 20 seconds, or about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for it to fully grow. It is recommended to replant some in a safe space as soon as the player finds it. Fully grown Flax will be harvested when damaged by weapons. Area of Effect attacks, such as those of the [[Stagbreaker]], [[Iron Sledge]], or [[Atgeirs]] secondary attack, are very effective for fast harvesting. No Flax is lost, however, these methods do not grant experience towards the [[Farming (Skill)|Farming skill]], and the chance of extra yields will not trigger. As such, using a [[Scythe]] or harvesting by hand have potentially better yield. ==Usage== ===Building=== * {{Item link|Straw}} ===Crafting=== * {{Item link|Linen Thread}} via {{Item link|Spinning Wheel}} ===Farming=== * 2 Flax can be obtained by planting and growing a single Flax using the [[Cultivator]]. ===Taming=== * {{Item link|Lox|size=64px}} {{MaterialsNav}} [[Category:Seeds]] [[Category:Farming]] [[Fr:Lin]] [[ru:Лен]] [[cs:Len]] [[uk:Льон]] [[de:Flachs]]

10 }} }} }} The '''Caller Set''' is a [[Deep North]]-tier mage [[armor]]. == Armor pieces == This set of armor has three pieces. The pieces cannot be crafted directly. Instead the player must craft the corresponding [[Cast]] at a level 3 [[Galdr Table]] and harden it in a [[Frost Foundry]]. Hardening a cast takes 50 seconds and burns [[Liquid Frost]] as fuel at one unit every 10 seconds, and five units are required per cast. The armor can be repaired at a level 3 Galdr Table. Since the maximum Galdr Table level is 5, the pieces cannot currently be upgraded past quality 3. The [[Forge of Potential]] upgrade for these pieces uses a [[Bloodgold Protection Idol]].
